My committee took the first step in funding Border Patrol and DHS over the next 3 years. We’re not going to sit by and allow the Democrats to defund border enforcement and security.


Leader John Thune (@LeaderJohnThune)

Because of Democrats’ historic temper tantrum, we will be funding Border Patrol and ICE for the full remainder of President Trump’s term.

We are going to pass the Secure America Act, and with it, we are going to end this conversation about defunding the police.

Video

Sad to hear @TulsiGabbard must step aside. Kelley and I are keeping her and Abraham in our prayers. She fought the deep state head-on, exposed bad actors, and was genuinely helpful in uncovering the truth behind the COVID cover-up. Washington could use more people willing to challenge the system as she did.

As Chairman of the committee, I can promise you this: Border Patrol and ICE will get paid. Fentanyl, weapons, and nuclear material inspections will continue. Child sex trafficking interdiction at the border will be funded. Democrats will not win this fight.

No gimmicks. No riders. No midnight surprises. Just a clean vote to fund Border Patrol and ICE. Every Democrat voted no. Remember that the next time they tell you they support border security.

Let me be clear about what reconciliation is and isn't. It was designed to balance the budget. Not fund the government. Not grow spending. Democrats forced this process, and now we're paying the price.

And I have the bill to fund the ballroom with ZERO tax dollars.  Why would the Democrats stop that?


Rand Paul (@RandPaul)

My bill doesn't just rubber-stamp a ballroom. It creates a permanent process: any White House addition must be approved by the Oversight Committee chair and the National Capital Planning Commission chair. Private funding only. No blank checks.
